components.css: .ds-table { font-family: "Geist", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, #1c1917); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table summary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.4rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; list-style: none; cursor: pointer; } .ds-table summary:hover { border-color: #f3cd6a; background: #fcf4d2; } .ds-table summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring, #4f3f28); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-table .wrap { margin-top: 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #e7e5e4); border-radius: 14px; overflow-x: auto; } .ds-table table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-table caption { padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e7e5e4); text-align: left; font-size: 0.825rem; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b645d); } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 0.6rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #e7e5e4); text-align: left; } .ds-table thead th { background: var(--surface, #fafaf9); font-weight: 500; color: var(--muted-foreground, #6b645d); } .ds-table .num { text-align: right; } .ds-table .small td { border-bottom: 1px dashed #c47a1e; } .ds-table .note { margin-left: 0.35rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid #f3cd6a; border-radius: 999px; background: #fcf4d2; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #8a5210; }

narrative.overview: The site uses the visual language of shadcn/ui: a white page, warm stone neutrals, rounded cards with a 1px border and soft shadow, small medium-weight labels, and one family (Geist). shadcn/ui is a React + Tailwind library; this site stays plain HTML, one CSS file and vanilla JavaScript, so the components are recreated in CSS under shadcn's token names. Warmth and brand come from the power logo: butter is the accent, deep bark the primary and focus colour, bark the chart colour, and bolt orange marks the one data point under discussion.
keyCharacteristics: White ground, warm stone neutrals, butter only in the hero and page-header gradients and in accents.
Primary actions and the current nav tab are filled deep bark; hover uses butter.
One family, Geist, with tight negative tracking on headings and tabular figures.
Every chart ships a data-table alternative; small samples are dashed and labelled.

rules.name: Logo Palette Rule
rules.body: Every hue is the logo's butter, bark or bolt, or a warm stone neutral. New charts add no new hues without a documented reason.

rules.name: Token Rule
rules.body: Colours are referenced through the shadcn-named custom properties in :root (background, foreground, muted, primary, accent, border, input, ring, surface). No raw colour values outside the token block, except the select chevron's data URI.

rules.name: Bolt Means Look Here Rule
rules.body: Bolt orange fills at most one mark per chart, the one the adjacent sentence names, plus the eyebrow dot and small-sample rule. It is never a focus or hover colour.

rules.name: Card Rule
rules.body: Grouped content sits in a card: white, 1px border, 14px radius, soft shadow. One card style for the verdict, rail, method, calculator, results and info panel.

rules.name: Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Every control shows a 2px deep-bark outline at 2px offset on focus (10:1 on white, 8.2:1 on butter).

rules.name: Touch Target Rule
rules.body: Buttons, nav links, inputs and the data-table toggle are at least 44px tall.

rules.name: Twin Table Rule
rules.body: No chart ships without a data table carrying the same numbers.

rules.name: Dashed Sample Rule
rules.body: Small or unreliable groups are marked by a dashed line and a text badge together, never by colour alone.

rules.name: Grow Once Rule
rules.body: The only authored motion is data growing from zero, once, on first view. Reduced motion shows the final state.

rules.name: Plain Stack Rule
rules.body: shadcn/ui is recreated in CSS only: no React, Tailwind, build step or inline styles. Everything lives in assets/css/styles.css.

dos: Do use the shadcn-named tokens in :root for every colour.
Do put grouped content in the one card style.
Do fill the single data mark the prose names with bolt orange and every other mark with bark.
Do mark the current page with the filled deep-bark tab and nav hover with the deep-butter fill.
Do keep every control at least 44px tall with the deep-bark focus outline.
Do ship a data table with every chart, start value axes at zero and name the source in the caption.
donts: Don't add React, Tailwind, a build step or inline styles.
Don't use bolt orange for focus, hover, buttons or body text.
Don't write raw colour values outside the token block.
Don't use green gradients, leaf icons or a grid of KPI cards.
Don't encode meaning by colour alone.
